cases.question: 列出最近 20 条待整改的体系审核发现项

cases.question: 2026年7月和8月的销售订单数量相差多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01')) - (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01')) AS diff FROM sal_sales_orders

cases.question: 上个月和上上个月相比，充电次数变化了多少次？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND started_at < date_trunc('month', now()))) - (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE started_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - INTERVAL '2 months' AND started_at < date_trunc('month', now()) - INTERVAL '1 month')) AS diff FROM iot_charging_sessions

cases.question: 2026年8月的销售订单量比7月增长了百分之多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01')) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01') AS growth_pct FROM sal_sales_orders

cases.question: 2026年8月17日比2026年8月10日的销售订单量相差多少？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= '2026-08-17' AND created_at < '2026-08-18')) - (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= '2026-08-10' AND created_at < '2026-08-11')) AS diff FROM sal_sales_orders
cases._note: 固定日期（不随时间漂移），锚点在数据区间内 —— 对照 AUF43

cases.question: 2026年9月11日当天有多少张销售订单？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sal_sales_orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-11' AND created_at < '2026-09-12'
cases._note: ★ 这个案例记录的是一类**系统性缺陷**而非能力题：所有种子表的 时间上界都停在生成脚本跑的那天（实测 2026-09-16），而 now() 永远在其之后， 所以窗口必为空 → 0。危险不在 0 本身，而在摘要会把它解释成业务事实（实测原话：「本月17号销量归零…呈断崖式下滑」）。 它属于「空结果集案例有害」那一类：判分上是 0 行 = 0 行，恒过， 但语义上系统给了一个错误结论。修法是给 runtime 注入数据上界（见 §9.3）。

cases.question: 各个汽车品牌分别卖出了多少台车？（按订单数统计）
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders o
JOIN sal_deliveries d ON d.order_id = o.id
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON d.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series ms ON m.series_id = ms.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON ms.brand_id = b.id
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各大区、各品牌的销售额分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT r.name AS region, b.name AS brand, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount
FROM sal_sales_orders o
JOIN sal_regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
JOIN sal_deliveries d ON d.order_id = o.id
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON d.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series ms ON m.series_id = ms.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON ms.brand_id = b.id
GROUP BY r.name, b.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC

cases.question: 各个工厂生产的车分别卖给了哪些大区的客户？统计每个工厂-大区组合的订单量
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT p.name AS plant, r.name AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders o
JOIN sal_deliveries d ON d.order_id = o.id
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON d.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN mfg_plants p ON v.plant_id = p.id
JOIN sal_regions r ON o.region_id = r.id
GROUP BY p.name, r.name ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 各款型的平均成交金额是多少？按款型名称列出
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT t.name AS trim, ROUND(AVG(o.amount), 2) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders o
JOIN veh_trims t ON o.trim_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY avg_amount DESC

cases.question: 各品牌的售后维修工单数分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS wo_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders wo
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON wo.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series ms ON m.series_id = ms.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON ms.brand_id = b.id
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY wo_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各大区的维修工单总数和平均工时分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT r.name AS region, COUNT(*) AS wo_cnt, ROUND(AVG(wo.labor_hours), 2) AS avg_hours
FROM svc_work_orders wo
JOIN svc_service_centers sc ON wo.service_center_id = sc.id
JOIN sal_regions r ON sc.region_id = r.id
GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY wo_cnt DESC

cases.question: 维修工单里消耗金额最高的前 5 个零件名称和总金额
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT p.name AS part, ROUND(SUM(wp.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM svc_wo_parts wp
JOIN plm_parts p ON wp.part_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 各工厂、各车型的生产记录条数分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT p.name AS plant, m.name AS model, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM mfg_production_records pr
JOIN mfg_plants p ON pr.plant_id = p.id
JOIN veh_models m ON pr.model_id = m.id
GROUP BY p.name, m.name ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 各车间的设备故障次数排行，列出车间名和故障数
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT w.name AS workshop, COUNT(*) AS fault_cnt
FROM mfg_equipment_faults ef
JOIN mfg_equipment e ON ef.equipment_id = e.id
JOIN mfg_workshops w ON e.workshop_id = w.id
GROUP BY w.name ORDER BY fault_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各整车品牌在质量检验中不合格的记录数是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS fail_cnt
FROM mfg_quality_inspections qi
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON qi.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series ms ON m.series_id = ms.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON ms.brand_id = b.id
WHERE qi.result <> 'pass'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY fail_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各供应商的 PPM 记录平均 PPM 值是多少？按供应商名称列出
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT s.name AS supplier, ROUND(AVG(pp.ppm), 2) AS avg_ppm
FROM qms_ppm_records pp
JOIN plm_suppliers s ON pp.supplier_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY avg_ppm DESC, s.name ASC

cases.question: 各工厂的体系审核发现项数量统计，按发现项数降序
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT p.name AS plant, COUNT(*) AS finding_cnt
FROM qms_audit_findings f
JOIN qms_audits a ON f.audit_id = a.id
JOIN mfg_plants p ON a.plant_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY finding_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各品牌的电池包故障记录数分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS fault_cnt
FROM bat_battery_faults bf
JOIN bat_battery_packs bp ON bf.pack_id = bp.id
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON bp.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series ms ON m.series_id = ms.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON ms.brand_id = b.id
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY fault_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各电池供应商的电池包平均健康度（SOH）是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT s.name AS supplier, ROUND(AVG(soh.soh), 2) AS avg_soh, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM bat_soh_records soh
JOIN bat_battery_packs bp ON soh.pack_id = bp.id
JOIN plm_suppliers s ON bp.supplier_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY avg_soh DESC

cases.question: 各车型的智驾测试接管事件数统计
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT m.name AS model, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ad_disengagements ad
JOIN ad_test_drives td ON ad.test_drive_id = td.id
JOIN ad_test_vehicles tv ON td.test_vehicle_id = tv.id
JOIN veh_models m ON tv.model_id = m.id
GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY cnt DESC

cases.question: 各类道路类型的智驾场景通过率分别是多少百分比？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT s.road_type,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sr.passed = 'yes') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS pass_rate
FROM ad_scenario_runs sr
JOIN ad_scenarios s ON sr.scenario_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.road_type ORDER BY pass_rate DESC

cases.question: 各品牌的 OTA 安装失败次数分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS fail_cnt
FROM ota_install_failures f
JOIN ota_installations i ON f.installation_id = i.id
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON i.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series ms ON m.series_id = ms.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON ms.brand_id = b.id
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY fail_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各零件类别的采购订单行数量统计
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT pc.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS line_cnt
FROM pur_po_lines pl
JOIN plm_parts p ON pl.part_id = p.id
JOIN plm_part_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.id
GROUP BY pc.name ORDER BY line_cnt DESC

cases.question: 各供应商的零件数量是多少？按零件数降序
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT s.name AS supplier, COUNT(*) AS part_cnt
FROM plm_supplier_parts sp
JOIN plm_suppliers s ON sp.supplier_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY part_cnt DESC, s.name ASC

cases.question: 2026年上半年（1~6月）各大区的销售订单量分别是多少？

cases.question: 2026年第一季度各品牌的售后工单数统计
cases.golden_sql:

FROM svc_work_orders wo

cases.question: 卖得最好的前 5 个经销商，各自的订单数和总销售额是多少？

cases.question: 工作日和周末的充电记录分别有多少条？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM started_at) >= 6 THEN '周末' ELSE '工作日' END AS day_type,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM iot_charging_sessions
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: 各工单类型里还有多少工单没完工？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT wo_type, COUNT(*) AS unfinished_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders
WHERE finished_at IS NULL
GROUP BY wo_type ORDER BY wo_type

cases.question: 研发缺陷问题单按状态分布，各有多少条？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM alm_issues GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

cases.question: 各动力类型下分别有多少个车型？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT e.name AS energy_type, COUNT(*) AS model_cnt
FROM veh_models m
JOIN veh_energy_types e ON m.energy_type_id = e.id
GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY e.name

cases.question: 各城市分别有多少家经销商？
cases.golden_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS dealer_cnt FROM sal_dealers GROUP BY city ORDER BY city

cases.question: 2026年8月进厂的维修工单有多少张？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM svc_work_orders
WHERE intake_at >= '2026-08-01' AND intake_at < '2026-09-01'

cases.question: 2026年7月1日到8月31日（暑假）总共充了多少度电？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT SUM(energy_kwh) AS total_kwh FROM iot_charging_sessions
WHERE started_at >= '2026-07-01' AND started_at < '2026-09-01'

cases.question: 2025年第四季度每个月分别卖出了多少张销售订单？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) AS mon, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders
WHERE created_at >= '2025-10-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', created_at) ORDER BY mon

cases.question: 2026年6月1日到6月18日（618大促）的销售订单总金额和订单数是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-06-01' AND created_at < '2026-06-19'

cases.question: 2026年8月15日到9月15日期间，周末进厂的维修工单有多少张？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM svc_work_orders
WHERE intake_at >= '2026-08-15' AND intake_at < '2026-09-16'
  AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM intake_at) >= 6

cases.question: 2025年10月到12月每月的 OTA 安装失败次数分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS mon, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ota_install_failures
WHERE occurred_at >= '2025-10-01' AND occurred_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', occurred_at) ORDER BY mon

cases.question: 各动力类型的维修工单分别有多少张？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT e.name AS energy_type, COUNT(*) AS wo_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON w.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_energy_types e ON m.energy_type_id = e.id
GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY e.name

cases.question: 各服务中心还有多少张维修工单没完工？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT c.name AS center, COUNT(*) AS unfinished_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN svc_service_centers c ON w.service_center_id = c.id
WHERE w.finished_at IS NULL
GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: 各品牌的已交付订单分别有多少张？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS delivered_cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders o
JOIN veh_trims t ON o.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series s ON m.series_id = s.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON s.brand_id = b.id
WHERE o.status = '已交付'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY b.name

cases.question: 各车型的平均进厂里程是多少公里？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT m.name AS model, ROUND(AVG(w.mileage), 2) AS avg_mileage
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON w.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY m.name

cases.question: 各车系的平均试驾评分是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT s.name AS series, AVG(td.score) AS avg_score
FROM sal_test_drives td
JOIN veh_models m ON td.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series s ON m.series_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY s.name

cases.question: 2026年上半年各品牌分别收到了多少张销售订单？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders o
JOIN veh_trims t ON o.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series s ON m.series_id = s.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON s.brand_id = b.id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY b.name

cases.question: 机电维修类型的工单，各服务中心分别承担了多少张？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT c.name AS center, COUNT(*) AS wo_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN svc_service_centers c ON w.service_center_id = c.id
WHERE w.wo_type = '机电维修'
GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

cases.question: 各城市的试驾次数分别是多少？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT d.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS drive_cnt
FROM sal_test_drives td
JOIN sal_dealers d ON td.dealer_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.city ORDER BY d.city

cases.question: 各品牌的三电维修工单分别有多少张？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, COUNT(*) AS wo_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON w.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series s ON m.series_id = s.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON s.brand_id = b.id
WHERE w.wo_type = '三电维修'
GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY b.name

cases.question: 工单量最大的前3个服务中心是哪些？列出名称和工单数
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT c.name AS center, COUNT(*) AS wo_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN svc_service_centers c ON w.service_center_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY wo_cnt DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 未完工工单最多的前5个服务中心是哪些？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT c.name AS center, COUNT(*) AS unfinished_cnt
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN svc_service_centers c ON w.service_center_id = c.id
WHERE w.finished_at IS NULL
GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY unfinished_cnt DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 充电量最大的前3个城市是哪些？列出城市和总电量
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT city, SUM(energy_kwh) AS total_kwh
FROM iot_charging_sessions
GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_kwh DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 卖得最好的前5个车型（款型）是哪些？按订单数排
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT t.name AS trim, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM sal_sales_orders o
JOIN veh_trims t ON o.trim_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY order_cnt DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 查一下维修工单 SWO00000001 的状态、进厂时间和完工时间
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT wo_no, status, intake_at, finished_at
FROM svc_work_orders WHERE wo_no = 'SWO00000001'

cases.question: 2026年9月1日到9月15日进厂的维修工单，按工单号从小到大列出前10条的工单号和状态
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT wo_no, status
FROM svc_work_orders
WHERE intake_at >= '2026-09-01' AND intake_at < '2026-09-16'
ORDER BY wo_no LIMIT 10

cases.question: 订单 SO00000001 的金额、状态和下单时间是什么？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT order_no, amount, status, created_at
FROM sal_sales_orders WHERE order_no = 'SO00000001'

cases.question: 维修工单 SWO00000042 对应的车辆属于哪个品牌、哪个车系、哪个款型？
cases.golden_sql:
SELECT b.name AS brand, s.name AS series, t.name AS trim
FROM svc_work_orders w
JOIN veh_vehicles v ON w.vehicle_id = v.id
JOIN veh_trims t ON v.trim_id = t.id
JOIN veh_models m ON t.model_id = m.id
JOIN veh_model_series s ON m.series_id = s.id
JOIN veh_brands b ON s.brand_id = b.id
WHERE w.wo_no = 'SWO00000042'
